# Metrowide Appraisals

> Residential home appraisal services in Minneapolis-Saint Paul, MN. Specializing in divorce, estate, tax appeal, PMI removal, and FSBO appraisals. Licensed in Minnesota and Wisconsin. 25 years of experience. Standard fee: $495.

## About

Metrowide Appraisals is owned and operated by Ben Goheen, Minnesota Certified Residential Appraiser (License #20303548). All appraisals are USPAP-compliant and court-ready. The business has served the Twin Cities metro since 2001.

## Services

- [Divorce Appraisal](https://metrowide.co/divorce-appraisal) — Court-ready valuations for equitable property division in Minnesota divorces
- [Estate Appraisal](https://metrowide.co/estate-appraisal) — IRS-compliant appraisals for probate, trust settlement, and date-of-death valuations
- [Tax Appeal Appraisal](https://metrowide.co/tax-appeal-appraisal) — Independent valuations to support property tax appeals in Hennepin, Ramsey, Dakota, Anoka, and Washington counties
- [PMI Removal Appraisal](https://metrowide.co/pmi-removal-appraisal) — Certified appraisals to prove 20% equity and cancel private mortgage insurance
- [FSBO / Pre-Listing Appraisal](https://metrowide.co/selling-your-home) — Professional valuations for homeowners selling without an agent

## Service Area

Hennepin County, Ramsey County, Dakota County, Anoka County, Washington County (Minnesota), and St. Croix County (Wisconsin). Cities include Minneapolis, St. Paul, Bloomington, Edina, Eagan, Burnsville, Woodbury, Maple Grove, Plymouth, Stillwater, and 60+ additional communities.

## Pricing

Standard single-family home, townhome, or condo: $495. Complex or unique properties quoted on request.
